query:
UPDATE copilot_drafts
                SET status = $1, updated_at = $2, lease_expires_at = NULL,
                    last_error = COALESCE(last_error, 'attempts exhausted')
              WHERE status = ANY($3::TEXT[])
                AND kind = ANY($5::TEXT[])
                AND attempts >= $4
                AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < $2)
